newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka's Vanik says plans to buy Forbes.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka's Vanik says plans to buy Forbes.

text.p: Sri Lankan investment bank Vanik Incorporation Ltd said on Thursday that it intended to make an offer for a controlling interest in Forbes Ceylon Ltd.

"It is only an intention as yet. Whether it develops into a firm offer depends on Vanik's decision to proceed with the idea and Forbes' foreign principal shareholder, Canada's Global Equity Corportion, agreeing to it," said a senior Vanik official who declined to be identified.
Global Equity Corp controls 50 percent of Forbes' equity.

Vanik earlier asked the Colombo Stock Exchange to make an announcement on the trading floor that if the takeover offer was acceptable to the principal shareholder, it would make a similar offer to smaller shareholders.
The company official said that Vanik was informing the market of its intention in order to allay fears that could lead to speculation.
Forbes Ceylon manages plantations and is a major player in the commodities, real estate and tourism sectors.
